{"columns": [
  {"name": "ca", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "Baseline cancer status (none/yes/metastatic) known at study entry."},
  {"name": "sfdm2", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Functional-disability outcome recorded at 2-month follow-up, and one of its levels encodes death before follow-up."},
  {"name": "sps", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.82, "reason": "SUPPORT physiology score computed from day-3 baseline physiology, final at prediction time."},
  {"name": "crea", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 serum creatinine lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "race", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Fixed demographic recorded at enrollment."},
  {"name": "edu", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Years of education collected in the baseline interview."},
  {"name": "ph", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 arterial pH lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "surv6m", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.6, "reason": "SUPPORT model 6-month survival estimate generated at day 3; strongly predictive but not computed from the observed outcome."},
  {"name": "temp", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 temperature measurement, final at baseline."},
  {"name": "sex", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Fixed demographic recorded at enrollment."},
  {"name": "bili", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 bilirubin lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "hospdead", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "In-hospital death indicator: hospdead=1 forces death=1, so the target is partly reconstructible from it."},
  {"name": "aps", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.82, "reason": "APACHE III day-3 physiology score built from baseline measurements."},
  {"name": "resp", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 respiration rate, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "dnrday", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.6, "reason": "Day on which a DNR order was written can fall after the day-3 prediction point, so it is not yet final."},
  {"name": "surv2m", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.6, "reason": "SUPPORT model 2-month survival estimate generated at day 3; predictive but not derived from the outcome."},
  {"name": "id", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.7, "reason": "Record identifier assigned at enrollment; exists and is fixed at prediction time (though not a legitimate feature)."},
  {"name": "adls", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "Surrogate-reported activities-of-daily-living index from the baseline interview."},
  {"name": "totcst", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.88, "reason": "Total ratio-of-costs-to-charges cost accrues over the whole stay and is final only at discharge."},
  {"name": "prg6m", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.75, "reason": "Physician's 6-month survival estimate recorded at study entry; a prediction, not an outcome-derived value."},
  {"name": "bun", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 blood urea nitrogen lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "sod", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 serum sodium lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "glucose", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Day-3 glucose lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "age", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Age at enrollment, fixed and known at prediction time."},
  {"name": "d.time", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Days of follow-up to death or censoring; the death indicator is defined jointly with this survival time."},
  {"name": "alb", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 serum albumin lab value, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "adlp", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "Patient-reported activities-of-daily-living index from the baseline interview."},
  {"name": "dzclass", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Broad diagnosis class assigned at study entry."},
  {"name": "scoma", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.88, "reason": "Day-3 Glasgow-based coma score, part of the baseline assessment."},
  {"name": "wblc", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 white blood cell count, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "hday", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85, "reason": "Hospital day on which the patient entered the study; known at enrollment."},
  {"name": "charges", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "Hospital charges accumulate through the stay and are finalized only at discharge/billing."},
  {"name": "hrt", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 heart rate, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "dementia", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Pre-existing comorbidity recorded at enrollment."},
  {"name": "avtisst", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.8, "reason": "Average TISS score over days 3-25 averages intensity of care occurring after the prediction point."},
  {"name": "totmcst", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.88, "reason": "Total micro-cost for the hospitalization is only final after the stay ends."},
  {"name": "num.co", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Count of pre-existing comorbidities recorded at enrollment."},
  {"name": "adlsc", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.8, "reason": "Imputed/calibrated ADL score derived from the baseline ADL responses."},
  {"name": "pafi", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Day-3 PaO2/FiO2 ratio computed from baseline blood gas values."},
  {"name": "income", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Income bracket collected in the baseline interview."},
  {"name": "meanbp", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Day-3 mean arterial blood pressure, measured at baseline."},
  {"name": "slos", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.92, "reason": "Days from study entry to discharge is only known once the stay ends, after the prediction point."},
  {"name": "diabetes", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.94, "reason": "Pre-existing comorbidity recorded at enrollment."},
  {"name": "prg2m", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.75, "reason": "Physician's 2-month survival estimate recorded at study entry; a forecast, not an outcome-derived value."},
  {"name": "dzgroup", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.93, "reason": "Primary disease group assigned at study entry."},
  {"name": "urine", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.88, "reason": "Day-3 urine output, part of the baseline physiology panel."},
  {"name": "dnr", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.72, "reason": "DNR status as of day 3, i.e. status at the prediction point, though it reflects care decisions rather than the outcome."}
]}
